name: LLM Council
description: LLM Council after Karpathy and Ole Lehmann: five thinking-lens advisors (Contrarian, First Principles, Expansionist, Outsider, Executor) on Opus, Sonnet and Gemini answer, review each other anonymously, and an Opus chairman delivers the verdict.
author: eskwisit
safetyNotes: Declarative skill only. agent.prompt.inject is used solely to index the LLM Council skill for the agent's Skill tool; main.js does nothing at runtime. The bundled scripts/council.py is run by the agent through its normal shell tool: it anonymizes answers, parses rankings and writes a report in the workspace run directory, and on request copies the seven council sub-agent definitions (subagents/*.md) to ~/.agents/subagents, the only place PI-Desktop loads sub-agents from. During a run it keeps the secret label map and anonymized answers in ~/.llm-council/private/ so reviewers cannot read them, and it reads PI-Desktop's session log only to look up which model answered a delegation. It makes no network calls.
